CommunityApplications.Profile:
Sylo is a multi-function Discord bot with a MEE6-style web dashboard, built for self-hosting on Unraid.
It has a per-guild module system (30 modules) — moderation with warning thresholds and a numbered case log (/history, /case), server logging, tickets/modmail answered from the dashboard, reaction roles & autoroles, verification (button or Cloudflare Turnstile captcha), welcome/leave messages, birthday announcements, sticky messages, auto-moderation (optionally pushed to Discord's native AutoMod), a counting game, custom slash commands, an autoresponder, recurring reminders, leveling (text + voice XP, XP multipliers, all-time/weekly/monthly leaderboard), AFK, live-count server-stat voice channels, server insights (activity charts including voice usage), a free-games notifier, ban appeals, MEE6-style temporary voice channels, a starboard, an invite tracker, reaction polls, prize giveaways, Battlefield-series and RuneScape (OSRS/RS3) player stats, Twitch / YouTube / Kick go-live alerts (with optional message cleanup when the stream ends), RSS/Atom feed alerts (plus Reddit / Mastodon / Bluesky handles), and a message/embed creator.
Optional "Log in with Discord" gates the dashboard to server admins. State lives in a single SQLite file on a mounted volume, snapshotted automatically (optionally shipped off-site to WebDAV or a Discord webhook) and restorable from the dashboard. A Prometheus /metrics endpoint and a ready-made Grafana dashboard are included. One Node 22 process, one container, no build step.
**Support:** open an issue at https://github.com/Ferdinand99/Sylo/issues
